about_the_game:
Courier Life Simulator: Demo gives you a first look at the daily grind and freedom of a courier’s life. This preview lets you step into the driver’s seat, take on a handful of deliveries, and get a taste of what’s to come in the full Early Access release.

In this demo, your workday is focused and straightforward — you’ll handle three delivery jobs, each with its own drop-off location. Load your packages, plan your route, and make your way across the city however you like. It’s up to you to decide the best way to get the job done.

Outside of deliveries, the demo also introduces the lifestyle side of the game. You’ll have access to your personal car, which you can drive freely, exploring the streets and taking in the world at your own pace. At the end of the day, head back to your small starter house — your first step toward the property, upgrades, and expanded living space that will be available in the full game.

What to Expect in the Demo

  • Three Package Deliveries – Try out the essential delivery gameplay loop in a compact, approachable session.

  • Your Own Car – Drive wherever you want, whenever you want, giving you a taste of open-world freedom.

  • Your Starter Home – Get a glimpse of the life simulation side of Courier Life, with your very first home base.

This is a small slice of the bigger picture — enough to get you behind the wheel, deliver some packages, and imagine the possibilities.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or Newer (64 bit) Windows OS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 (4GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or Newer (64 bit) Windows OS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 580 or better (6GB+ VRAM)
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Connect to your driver account on the warehouse desktop , get on shift and load the packages in the van. Deliver the packages , choosing the packages to deliver based on your own preferences. After the shift ends , leave the van at the warehouse and get your personal car and drive to your home.
